title: Finite Tate pullback derived and exponent coherence
statement: The Lean declaration `lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback-rest` states the corresponding strict package in the finite Tate pullback proof: the first package contains local trivialization and abelian/tensor coherence; the second contains only the remaining derived and exponent clauses, assuming the explicit base data.

proof.text: Compose the existing derived inverse-image tensor comparison with the single-complex pullback comparison induced by c. Whisker the pullback/shift comparison and these two comparisons to construct d; functoriality gives exactly its asserted component formula.

Write m′=m*k. Both m and k are units on T, so Kummer exactness makes multiplication by m and k on G_m epimorphic. Define q:ker(m*k)→ker(m) by restricting multiplication by k. Using lifts along these epimorphisms, prove that q is epimorphic and that ker(q) is the image of multiplication by m on ker(m*k). Thus q is the cokernel of that multiplication map.

By the sheafification and scalar-extension adjunctions, maps from the coefficient root line into an A-module sheaf P correspond naturally to additive maps from roots of unity into the underlying abelian sheaf of P. As mA=0, every such map from ker(m*k) annihilates multiplication by m and hence factors uniquely through q. The induced coefficient-line morphism is therefore an isomorphism by the coyoneda criterion. The adjunction formula at 1 tensor z gives the generator equation for coefficient 1; A-linearity gives the equation for every coefficient.

Extend the line isomorphism recursively by tensor products in nonnegative degrees and by precomposition with the inverse in negative degrees. The zero and positive recursion equations are definitional. Naturality of evaluation followed by cancellation of an isomorphism with its inverse proves the dual evaluation equation.

theorem etaleFiniteTwistPullback_rest (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (m : ℕ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hA : (m : A) = 0)
    (r : ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T),
        IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)) →
        ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v).obj (T.rootsOfUnitySheaf m) ≅
          T'.rootsOfUnitySheaf m))
    (c : ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T),
        IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)) → IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤)) → ∀ a : ℤ,
        (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).obj (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) ≅
          finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T' hA a)
    (p : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}), IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)) → ∀ a b : ℤ,
        finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a ⊗ finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA b ≅
          finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA (a + b)) :
        (∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (v : T' ⟶ T) (hT : IsUnit (m : Γ(T, ⊤)))
        (hT' : IsUnit (m : Γ(T', ⊤))) (a b : ℤ),
      ∃ d : ((Etale.derivedTensorRight (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a)) ⋙
          shiftFunctor _ b) ⋙ (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).leftDerivedFunctor ≅
        (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).leftDerivedFunctor ⋙
          Etale.derivedTensorRight (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T'
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T' hA a)) ⋙
              shiftFunctor _ b),
        ∀ K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A T,
          d.app K =
            ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).leftDerivedFunctor.commShiftIso b).app
              (((Etale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj K).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a))) ≪≫
            (shiftFunctor _ b).mapIso
              (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v K
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a)) ≪≫
              ((Etale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T').obj
                ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)).mapIso
                ((Etale.singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso
                  (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).app (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a) ≪≫
                (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso (c v hT hT' a)))) ∧
    (∀ (m' : ℕ), 0 < m' → ∀ (hdiv : m ∣ m')
        (T : Scheme.{u}),
      IsUnit (m' : Γ(T, ⊤)) →
      ∃ (q : T.rootsOfUnitySheaf m' ⟶ T.rootsOfUnitySheaf m)
        (t : ∀ a : ℤ, finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m' T
          ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff A (ringChar A) m').mpr
            (dvd_trans ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff A (ringChar A) m).mp hA) hdiv)) a ≅
          finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA a),
      q ≫ kernel.ι (m • 𝟙 T.gmSheaf) = (m' / m) • kernel.ι (m' • 𝟙 T.gmSheaf) ∧
      (∀ (W : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : A) (z : (T.rootsOfUnitySheaf m').obj.obj W),
        (t 1).hom.hom.app W (finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A m' T
          ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff A (ringChar A) m').mpr
            (dvd_trans ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff A (ringChar A) m).mp hA) hdiv)) W a z) =
          finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A m T hA W a (q.hom.app W z)) ∧
      t 0 = Iso.refl _ ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, t (.ofNat (n + 2)) =
        tensorIso (t (.ofNat (n + 1))) (t 1)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        tensorHom (t (.ofNat (n + 1))).hom (t (.negSucc n)).hom ≫
            (ihom.ev (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA (.ofNat (n + 1)))).app
              (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m T hA 0) =
          (ihom.ev (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m' T
          ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff A (ringChar A) m').mpr
            (dvd_trans ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff A (ringChar A) m).mp hA) hdiv))
            (.ofNat (n + 1)))).app
            (finiteEtaleTateSheaf A m' T
          ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff A (ringChar A) m').mpr
            (dvd_trans ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff A (ringChar A) m).mp hA) hdiv)) 0)))
